name: clinical_v0_constant_mask_query_prior
rationale: Composed final-layer weights identify units 198 and 38 as positive readout paths that activate for high normalized values. In 128 calibration patients, their active cases remain underestimated after the original affine correction; almost all are measured variables rather than static/administrative channels. Increase only these two effective output coefficients by 1%, a fixed conservative expansion of the existing learned paths. Negative GELU-tail contributions change in the opposite direction, also consistent with the common positive offset in the low/middle range. No fitting, gradients, optimizer or test data. A previous key-component amplification had a query-dependent sign and failed calibration. Instead, add a constant query offset to conditioning attention head 7 along its mean observed-mask key displacement. The fixed intended average counterfactual logit increment is +0.05. For LayerNorm affine output h, dot(h,1/gamma)=sum(beta/gamma); use this identity to encode the constant offset as a rank-one edit of existing query weights. Keys, values and all other heads remain exact. Calibration inputs supply the mean mask displacement while the interpolated values stay fixed; hidden target values do not enter construction. This is one analytic design, not fitting, a parameter sweep or optimization. Accuracy must be measured independently. V1 benchmark scores are already known; later tests are repeated benchmark assessments.
